name: FieldCamp
description:
FieldCamp is field service management software for service businesses —plumbers, electricians, HVAC, cleaning, landscaping and more. This connector lets Claude work directly with your FieldCamp account so you can run the business in plain language instead of clicking through screens.                                                                                                                                                                      
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
With it connected, you can:                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  • Clients — find, create and update clients; look up a client's jobs, invoices, payment history and documents.                                                                                                                       
  • Jobs & visits — list and filter jobs by status or date, create jobs, schedule visits, and check a technician's visit history.                                                                                                      
  • Scheduling — see the day's schedule, check for booking conflicts, and find available team members for a time slot.                                                                                                                 
  • Estimates & invoices — list and filter documents by status or amount, create estimates and invoices, and record payments.

_published_faq.name: How do I add FieldCamp to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add FieldCamp to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.fieldcamp.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the FieldCamp MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: FieldCamp lists 87 MCP tools, including check_team_schedule_conflicts, convert_request_to_estimate, create_calendar_event, create_client, create_document, create_job, create_product_service, create_purchase_order, create_request, create_task, create_tax, and create_vendor.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to FieldCamp?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to FieldCamp in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
FieldCamp requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
FieldCamp is developed by FieldCamp. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
